# skills.rest
> 113,000+ vetted agent skills for Claude, OpenClaw & Codex. One click to connect the library to your AI agent. Use on demand.

## What is skills.rest?

skills.rest is a curated, open library of executable AI agent skills. Each skill is a self-contained, installable package that extends the capabilities of AI agents like Claude. Skills cover 10 professional domains and are contributed by official partners, verified authors, and the community.

## Key Features

- 113,000+ vetted and indexed agent skills
- One-click installation via Claude Code CLI
- 10 professional domain categories
- Supports Claude Code, Claude.ai, and API integrations
- Free to use, community-driven

## How to Install a Skill

**Claude Code (recommended):**
Run the install command shown on any skill detail page in your terminal (Bash/Zsh or PowerShell).

**Claude.ai (manual):**
1. Download the skill .zip package from the skill detail page
2. Upload the extracted files in your Claude.ai project settings
3. Activate with the /skill command

**API:**
Reference the skill package URL when calling the Anthropic API in your code.

## Categories

- Content & Communication — Writing, editing, social media management
- Data & Analytics — Data processing, visualization, analysis
- Design & Creative — Art generation, image editing, creative concepts
- Education & Research — Academic research, summarization, learning aids
- Finance & Accounting — Financial modeling, bookkeeping, market analysis
- Legal & Compliance — Contract review, regulatory checks, legal research
- Marketing & Sales — SEO, email campaigns, customer relationship tools
- Personal & Entrepreneur — Productivity, organization, startup resources
- Product & Management — Roadmapping, user stories, agile workflows
- Software Engineering — Code generation, debugging, documentation
